user.title: Connect to Nirvana
user.description: Use your existing Nirvana app account. Your password is used for sign-in only; a refresh token is stored in Home Assistant.

mfa.title: Verification code
mfa.description: Enter the code from your authenticator app, email or SMS.

error.invalid_auth: Invalid credentials, session or verification code.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach Nirvana. Try again later.
error.unsupported_challenge: Complete account activation, password reset or MFA setup in the official Nirvana app, then try again.
error.unexpected_response: The cloud response differs from the supported Nirvana API.
error.cognito_error: Nirvana rejected a sign-in step: {auth_error}. This does not necessarily mean the password is incorrect.

abort.already_configured: This Nirvana account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: Sign in with the original Nirvana account.
abort.unsupported_challenge: Complete account activation, password reset or MFA setup in the official Nirvana app, then try again.
